header.function_name: XD06 IF Cross Dock Master to GTOPAS

objective: To keep the cross dock destinations of each part in GTOPAS equal to NSP, by RPA: for every Active part waiting for synchronisation, the destinations of the ongoing period in Part Mapping per Destination (TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE_DEST) are compared with the destinations of the part in GTOPAS.

Per destination: in NSP and not in GTOPAS -> registered in GTOPAS; in both -> ignored (no change); in GTOPAS and not in NSP -> deleted in GTOPAS. Only the destination list is maintained: Pcs/Case, Max Case/Day, Effective Start Date and Case/Day are not sent (GTOPAS keeps no Case/Day per destination).
Parts that became Inactive are not sent: their destinations in GTOPAS are not changed.

Method: RPA bot on the GTOPAS screen. XD06 prepares the RPA input (part x destination) and receives the result per part; the status per part is kept in TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT (dummy table) and, together with XD07 (AP POLE), gives the overall Sync Status shown on the Cross Dock Part Master screen (XD01).

nodes.label: Select Waiting parts for GTOPAS (Inactive: not sent)
RPA: register / ignore / delete per destination in GTOPAS
Status per part, overall Sync Status, history

steps: [Sync] on XD01 sets the parts to Waiting (SYNC_STATUS = '3' in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE, IF_STATUS = '3' for 'GTOPAS' and 'APPOLE' in TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT) and starts XD06. Write LOG1.

steps.text: Select the parts with TARGET_SYSTEM = 'GTOPAS' and IF_STATUS = '3' in TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT. Keep CHANGED_DT of each part.
children: PART_STATUS Active: sent to the RPA (step 3).
PART_STATUS Inactive: not sent; IF_STATUS = '1', IF_MESSAGE = 'Inactive part: GTOPAS not changed' (step 6).
No Active part: go to step 6.

steps.text: Create the RPA input XD_CDMASTER_GTOPAS_<YYYYMMDDHHMMSS>.csv (see RPA Input Data):
children: Per Active part, one record per destination of the ongoing period in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE_DEST (PART_NO, PERIOD, DEST_CODE).
A part without destination: one record with DEST_CODE blank.
Same SEND_ID and SEND_DT on every record. Error: LOG3, all parts of the run Failed (step 6).

steps.text: Start the RPA bot with the input. Per part the bot opens the part in GTOPAS, reads its destinations and compares them with the input by DEST_CODE:
children: In the input and not in GTOPAS: register the destination in GTOPAS.
In the input and in GTOPAS: ignore (no change).
In GTOPAS and not in the input: delete the destination in GTOPAS.
The bot returns one result per part (see RPA Result Data). Part NG: LOG6. Bot not available or no result within the time limit: LOG4, all parts of the run Failed.

steps.text: Set the status of every part of the run in TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT:
children: RESULT 'OK': IF_STATUS = '1', IF_DT = now, IF_FILE_NAME = input file name, IF_MESSAGE = 'added <ADDED>; deleted <DELETED>' (blank when nothing changed).
RESULT 'NG', input or bot error: IF_STATUS = '2', IF_DT = now, IF_MESSAGE = reason (LOG3 / LOG4 / LOG6).

steps.text: Update the overall Sync Status of each part in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE and record the history:
children: CHANGED_DT differs from step 2 (part changed while sending): SYNC_STATUS = '0' (No Sync).
Else, status of 'GTOPAS' and of 'APPOLE' in TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT: one still '3' -> SYNC_STATUS stays '3'; both '1' -> '1' (Success); one '2' -> '2' (Failed, SYNC_MESSAGE = target + reason).
SYNC_DT = now when SYNC_STATUS becomes 1 or 2.
Insert TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE: event SYNC, source IF, FIELD_NAME SYNC_STATUS, REMARK = 'GTOPAS: ' + IF_MESSAGE.

steps: Write LOG2 with the input file name and the number of parts sent, destinations added / deleted and parts failed. Exit.

items: The D/S team maintains the destinations of each part on XD01 (Mapping per Destination of the ongoing period, created by XD05 process 2 and adjusted by screen or upload XD03).
Every change sets the part to No Sync. The D/S team clicks [Sync] when the changes are complete; only Active parts are sent to GTOPAS.

GTOPAS keeps the list of cross dock destinations per part (no Case/Day). The RPA bot makes this list equal to NSP: register a missing destination, ignore an existing one, delete one that is no longer in NSP.
Method: RPA bot on the GTOPAS screen (decided 30-Oct); screens and steps of the bot are detailed in the RPA design.

Parts that became Inactive (XD05 process 1) are not sent to GTOPAS and their destinations in GTOPAS are not changed (decided 30-Oct); their 'GTOPAS' row is set to '1', so the overall Sync Status follows XD07 (AP POLE).
Compared per part by DEST_CODE; PERIOD is always the ongoing period, past periods are never sent.
Pcs/Case, Max Case/Day, Effective Start Date and Case/Day are not sent. A change of Case/Day only gives no change in GTOPAS; the part still gets RESULT 'OK' (Success).
An Active part without destination: all its destinations in GTOPAS are deleted (TBC).
TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT is a dummy table that keeps the result per part and target; the real output of XD06 is the change made by the bot in GTOPAS.

Overall SYNC_STATUS: Waiting while a target is Waiting, Success when both targets are done, Failed when one target failed (the next [Sync] sends the part again; the comparison is repeatable, a part without difference gives no change).
A part changed on XD01 or by upload while it is being sent gets SYNC_STATUS = No Sync, so the newer data is sent by the next [Sync].
RPA design: GTOPAS screens, start of the bot by XD06, time limit, and how the result is returned (file or table) - TBC.
Active part without destination: delete all its destinations in GTOPAS - TBC.

tables.name: TB_R_CROSSDOCK_IF_RESULT
tables.description: Dummy table (proposed): send status of the cross dock master per part and target system (XD06 GTOPAS, XD07 AP POLE). The real output is the interface data sent to the target (AP POLE: file by SFTP; GTOPAS: RPA). The overall Sync Status of the part stays in TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE.
columns: Calculation period of the mapping sent (YYYYMM)
Date-time of the result of the target system
Name of the interface file (AP POLE) or RPA input file (GTOPAS)
Reason when Failed; blank when Success
User who last changed the record

tables.name: TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE
tables.description: Candidate part setting, one record per part (Part List data, no calculation period). Target of a successful upload.
columns: Minimum MAD (mandatory); reference compared with the MAD result of the calculation
Effective start date; required while the part is Candidate
Date-time of the last IF function result
Reason of the last Failed sync
Upload that last changed the record
User who last changed the record

tables.name: TB_M_PART_CANDIDATE_DEST
tables.description: Destination mapping, one record per part, calculation period and destination (Mapping per Destination data). Target of a successful upload.
columns: Calculation period, YYYYMM e.g. 202609; displayed as Sep 2026
Destination code (buyer code + PD code, 7 digits); exists in TB_M_H0125_DESTINATION (Destination Master)
User who last changed the record

tables.name: TB_H_PART_CANDIDATE
tables.description: History of every change of a crossdock part (Add / Edit by screen or upload, mapping changes, Sync results, status changes and mappings made by the calculation batches). Read by the History setting modal of Part List (index PART_NO, CREATED_DT). Proposed retention: 24 months online by CREATED_DT; a monthly housekeeping job deletes older records (period configurable in system master). To be confirmed.
columns: Calculation period YYYYMM for MAPPING / SYNC / CALC; NULL for ADD / EDIT (Part List has no period)
Upload of the change (Log); NULL when not from an upload
Destination code (7 digits) for MAPPING; NULL for other events
Changed field: PCS_CASE, MAX_CASE_DAY, MIN_MAD, PART_STATUS, EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, CASE_DAY, SYNC_STATUS
Value before the change; NULL for ADD or an added destination
Value after the change; NULL for a removed destination
Free text, e.g. SYNC_MESSAGE of a Failed sync
User who made the change (IF batch user ID for SYNC, batch user ID for BATCH)
Date and time of the change
